sections.markdown:
## JustGo_mobile slow views (> 30 s) and top 5 slowest JustGo services
The table below stays **empty until a breach happens**. A row appears only when the average view duration (`avg_ms`) for an `os.name` in a 1-minute window exceeds **30 s (30,000 ms)**. For each breach window it lists the 5 slowest services tagged `justgo` (by average response time in that same minute), along with the number of user actions in that window.

- `duration` in `user.events` is stored in nanoseconds, so it is divided by 1,000,000 to get ms.
- `dt.service.request.response_time` is in microseconds, so it is divided by 1,000.
- Services are picked with the entity selector `tag(justgo)` (tag key `justgo`); change it if the tag is a key:value pair.
- To change the threshold, edit `filter avg_ms > 30000`.

sections.title: JustGo_mobile slow views (> 30 s) with top 5 slowest JustGo services

input.value:
fetch user.events
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| filter frontend.name == "JustGo_mobile"
| summarize { avg_ms = avg(toDouble(duration)) / 1000000, useraction_count = count() },
    by: { window_start = bin(timestamp, 1m), os.name }
| filter avg_ms > 30000
| fieldsAdd window_end = window_start + 1m
| join [
    timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time), by: { dt.entity.service }, interval: 1m,
      filter: in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector("type(SERVICE),tag(justgo)"))
    | fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service)
    | fieldsAdd pts = iCollectArray(record(ts = timeframe[start] + interval * iIndex(), rt_ms = rt[] / 1000))
    | expand pts
    | fields ts = pts[ts], rt_ms = pts[rt_ms], service
    | filter isNotNull(rt_ms)
  ], kind: leftOuter, on: { left[window_start] == right[ts] }, fields: { service, rt_ms }
| summarize { services = collectArray(record(rt_ms, service)) },
    by: { window_start, window_end, os.name, avg_ms, useraction_count }
| fieldsAdd top5 = arraySlice(arraySort(services, direction: "descending"), from: 0, to: 5)
| expand top5
| fields `Window start` = window_start, `Window end` = window_end, `OS` = os.name,
    `Avg view duration (ms)` = round(avg_ms, decimals: 0), `User actions` = useraction_count,
    `JustGo service` = top5[service], `Service avg response (ms)` = round(top5[rt_ms], decimals: 0)
| sort `Window start` desc, `Service avg response (ms)` desc
